description: onestop hooks - one Node dispatcher in exec form, so they run natively on Windows, macOS and Linux with no shell. Every hook is silent outside an active onestop run. The PreToolUse guard is the only one that can stop anything, and only during a run: it blocks destructive git, recursive deletes, publishes, deploys, downloads piped to a shell, unapproved dependencies, and any commit, push or pull request the user did not choose at the ship gate.
